build_system: Vite 8.0.16 with Vue plugin, npm scripts
test_framework: None detected in package.json - manual testing required
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run type-check' to ensure no TypeScript errors. 2. Start dev server with 'npm run dev'. 3. Manually test QR menu flow: scan QR code -> view menu -> add items to cart -> view cart -> place order (room charge) -> place order (Chapa payment) -> verify order status page receives correct order ID. 4. Verify all existing functionality works: QR token detection, room/table context, guest info display, add/remove cart items, quantity controls, subtotal/tax/service charge calculations, room-charge ordering, Chapa payment flow, order status redirect with order ID.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - this is a refactoring task that doesn't generate build artifacts to commit
environment_constraints: Local worktree with active dev server. Do NOT restart dev server on port. Vite hot-reload handles component changes automatically.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing functionality. Fix bugs: (1) order ID not passed to OrderStatusPage after order creation, (2) currency formatting inconsistency ('$' vs 'ETB' vs 'ETB $'). Use 'ETB' consistently without dollar sign. Match existing code style: Vue 3 Composition API with <script setup>, TypeScript with interfaces, Tailwind utility classes, existing import patterns.
key_patterns: Composables follow pattern: export function useXxx() returning reactive refs and methods (see useOrderStatus.ts). Components use <script setup lang="ts"> with defineProps/defineEmits. Types defined in src/types/*.ts. Services in src/services/*.ts use publicAxios. localStorage/sessionStorage for payment data persistence. useLanguageStore for i18n. Teleport to body for modals.
directory_structure: src/views/guest/ - page components; src/components/guest/qr-menu/ - QR menu specific components; src/composables/ - Vue composables; src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces; src/services/ - API services; src/stores/ - Pinia stores (useLanguageStore); src/router/ - Vue Router config
